answer: Square-root payouts for linked agents: every new agent parks a refundable deposit in an escrow harbor, and identities whose deposits trace back to one funding wallet get their rewards pooled and paid by square root, so ten clones post ten deposits yet earn about three shares. A public randomness beacon picks surprise epochs where suspected siblings must answer at once from different prompts, and shared timing exposes one operator. Cracking a walnut into ten pieces never yields more nut, so splitting costs more than it pays.
